canonical_statement: Provisional source-faithful scope: for a complete n-dimensional Riemannian manifold with Ricci curvature bounded below by (n-1)K, the first Dirichlet eigenvalue of a geodesic ball of admissible radius is at most the first Dirichlet eigenvalue of the radius-matched ball in the simply connected n-dimensional constant-curvature K model space.
domain_and_universes: A finite-dimensional complete Riemannian manifold M, dimension n, p in M, real K, and radius r satisfying the source's admissibility conditions; exact Lean universes remain open.
quantifiers: n, M, metric, p, K, r
hypotheses: r is positive and satisfies the source's cut-locus/model-radius restrictions

alternate_encodings.target: positive first Dirichlet Laplacian eigenvalue formulation

excluded_degenerate_cases: r = 0, non-admissible model radii, balls crossing restrictions required by the primary theorem, and the distinct sectional-curvature/lower-eigenvalue comparison direction are excluded pending source audit.
foundation_profile: Uninstantiated rev-5.6 analytic/Riemannian profile; classical choice, spectral theory, integration, and compactness dependencies remain to be audited.
tcb_profile: Lean 4 kernel plus pinned mathlib; exact toolchain and transitive dependencies remain open.
computation_profile: No numerical or oracle computation is credited at intake.
formal_system: Lean 4 + pinned mathlib (formal target construction deferred)
source_revisions: Discovery citation only: S. Y. Cheng, Math. Z. 143 (1975), 289-297, DOI 10.1007/BF01214381; immutable copy, theorem number, and errata audit remain open.
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on a changed source pinpoint, inequality direction, curvature/radius assumptions, spectral convention, Lean target, imports/toolchain, or rev-5.6 standard.
